jobs.name: bash
jobs.submit_line: srun -N1 -n1 -c2 bash -c echo nproc=$(nproc); grep Cpus_allowed_list /proc/self/status; lscpu | grep -E "^(Thread|Core|Socket|CPU\(s\)|Model name)"; /shared/envs/esm/bin/python -c "import torch,os; torch.set_num_threads(2); print(\"torch threads\", torch.get_num_threads(), \"interop\", torch.get_num_interop_threads()); print(torch.__config__.parallel_info())"

jobs.name: bash
jobs.submit_line: srun -N1 -n1 -c2 bash -c slurmd -C | head -1; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/slurmstepd.scope/job_$SLURM_JOB_ID/cpuset.cpus.effective 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/slurmstepd.scope/job_$SLURM_JOB_ID/step_$SLURM_STEP_ID/cpuset.cpus.effective 2>/dev/null; grep Cpus_allowed_list /proc/self/status
